overview_description.description: Hudl is a platform and software that provides video analysis and coaching tools for sports teams. It enables coaches to upload footage of games, practices, and opponents, break the video down, add illustrations, voice clips, and text feedback, and deliver the video and coaching notes to their athletes.

about_short_description.short_description: Hudl is a software platform that provides video analysis and coaching tools for sports teams.

product.name: Hudl Core Platform
product.description: A software platform for uploading, organizing, and analyzing sports video and data to support teams and coaches at all levels.

product.name: Hudl Focus Cameras
product.description: Automatic, hands-free cameras that capture and livestream sports events with features like automatic zoom and environmental adjustments.

product.name: Titan GPS
product.description: Wearable GPS technology that tracks athlete physical metrics such as speed, effort, and workload, integrated with video and stats in one system.

product.name: Hudl Assist
product.description: A tool that automatically generates data and analysis from uploaded sports video to provide insights for teams and coaches.

product.name: Hudl IQ
product.description: A football-specific data platform providing verified, detailed football data and contextual insights for coaching staff.

product.name: Wyscout
product.description: A global football video and statistics database used for scouting and recruitment purposes.
